title: Run lore check in CI on pull requests to dev
description: The fleet operating block makes a green lore check the definition of done for a docs change, but .github/workflows/ci.yml never runs it: the only jobs are 'check · manifests' and 'Tracker integrity'. The orchestrator measured the gap by ref on origin/dev at 2026-09-15T14:34Z (eight of ten repos share it; fleet-wide finding OPAG-146) and asked this repository to close its own. Local baseline before the change: lore 0.7.0, 'lore check' on dev at ba564ef reports 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml has a job named exactly "lore check" that runs lore check on every pull_request event and on pushes to dev and main, matching the existing trigger set of ci.yml

The job installs the lore version derived from the opum-lore federated pin in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (strip the leading v), and the quest version derived from the Quest CLI line in CLAUDE.md, so neither is a second hand-maintained pin
The job passes on this task's own PR run (cite the run id), and a negative test shows it fails on a deliberately broken docs bundle
CLAUDE.md is NOT edited to name the job as required; whether to add it to main's required-checks ruleset is recorded on the task as a follow-up for the user, not done here

finalSummary: Added a 'lore check' job to .github/workflows/ci.yml on the workflow's existing trigger set. lore is derived from the opum-lore pin in marketplace.json (resolved 0.7.0 on the run), quest from CLAUDE.md's managed block (0.6.0). Delivered in PR #99, CI run 34982638072: all three jobs pass, lore check reports 2 files, 0 errors. Negative test: a broken link in a scratch copy exits 6; a non-release pin ref trips the install guard. Follow-up for the user, not done here: add 'lore check' to main's required-checks ruleset (gh api repos/opum-ai/opum-marketplace/rules/branches/main currently requires only 'check · manifests' and 'Tracker integrity'), then name it in CLAUDE.md's Contributing section.
